model: attacks only at unoccupied vertices; exactly one occupied guard moves along one G-edge; every retained successor stays in the same eternal family
strict_scope: Every positive-rank terminal predecessor has a dominating unbanned response of lower restricted rank.
Every secondary corridor response is either dominating and lower-rank or has the stated private missed witness.
A minimum-rank retained direct-root terminal has singleton palette.
At a minimum-rank positive predecessor, every compulsory lower-rank alternate is absent from the unrestricted greatest family.
At positive-rank anchor restoration, the old terminal guard is forced to the attacked anchor and gives the stated lower-rank response.
With all three restricted kernels empty, a nonsingleton minimum terminal exists in one of the four cases of Corollary 5.1.
not_proved: A lower-rank restricted state belongs to the unrestricted greatest family.
Any of the four residual cases is impossible.
The complete k=3 case or the gamma-theta conjecture.
